preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE (r.rolname = 'nexus_svc' AND (r.rolname = current_user OR pg_catalog.pg_has_role(r.oid, current_user, 'USAGE'))) OR (r.rolname <> current_user AND pg_catalog.pg_has_role(r.oid, current_user, 'USAGE') AND NOT r.rolsuper AND NOT r.rolbypassrls AND r.rolcanlogin)

changeSet.comment: Owner-read SELECT policy ${driving_table}_owner_read on ${driving_schema}.${driving_table} for the migrating role (RDR-246): skipped whole (MARK_RAN) when nexus_svc, or any other login role subject to row-level security, is or inherits the migrating role; ends with a post-condition that RAISEs unless the policy names exactly the migrating role.
